faqs.question: How long does standard and freight furniture shipping take?
faqs.answer: Small decor ships within 24 hours via UPS/FedEx (2–4 business days). Accent chairs and rugs ship within 3–5 business days with live tracking. Custom walnut dining tables require 3–4 weeks white-glove delivery.

faqs.question: What is the return and damaged item policy?
faqs.answer: Unused decor can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. If an item arrives damaged, customers receive a free priority replacement or full refund—orders over $150 with damage photos are escalated to a senior specialist for immediate courier pickup.

faqs.question: Are virtual interior design consultations free?
faqs.answer: Yes, 30-minute Virtual Interior Styling and Custom Sizing Consultations are complimentary and available Monday through Saturday at 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, 15:30, and 17:00 PT.

faqs.question: Do you offer trade pricing for interior designers and hospitality?
faqs.answer: Yes! Verified trade partners receive 20% off retail pricing and dedicated project sourcing. We collect name, email, and project scope with explicit consent so our trade desk can send a custom quote.
